oneLiner: Renally cleared aminoglycoside — extend dosing interval (not reduce dose) in renal impairment; mandatory therapeutic drug monitoring (troughs <1 mg/L). Avoid prolonged courses.

oneLiner: Renally cleared and crystal-forming — reduce dose at eGFR <50, ensure adequate hydration (especially IV), monitor for neurotoxicity (confusion, myoclonus, hallucinations).

oneLiner: AVOID in CKD — precipitates AKI (prostaglandin-dependent renal perfusion), worsens hypertension, raises potassium, antagonises ACEi/ARB. Even short courses can tip vulnerable patients into AKI.

guidance.adjustment: Standard dose with shortest course; avoid if other risk factors (elderly, dehydration, on ACEi/ARB+diuretic 'triple whammy').

oneLiner: Renally and hepatically cleared with narrow therapeutic index — life-threatening accumulation (multi-organ toxicity) in severe CKD and with strong CYP3A4 / P-gp inhibitors. Reduce dose and increase interval; AVOID at CrCl <30 with these interactions.
